text:
Jordan: Quick sync — KeyShield (HSM vendor) wants to go live on the cloud marketplace next month. We need to lock SSO/SAML metadata, SCIM provisioning endpoint, KMS attest flow, and confirm the joint announcement embargo date.
Alyssa: Sounds good. From eng side: we validated the KMS handshake with their test HSM this morning. Need the final cert thumbprint and service account mapping.
Maria: Marketing: we need partner logos, 2-line blurbs, and a joint press quote by EOD Friday. Who owns the legal signoff for the quote?
Samir: Security: can we get the SAML metadata and ACS URL? Also want to confirm if KeyShield will support idp-initiated SSO or only sp-initiated.
Jordan: Samir — KeyShield said idp-initiated is supported, they just need our metadata at /saml/metadata.xml. For SCIM: they exposed POST /scim/v2/Users and PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}.
Claire: Ops: adding a quick smoke test plan — 1) provision SCIM user, 2) assert group mapping, 3) perform SSO login, 4) rotate KMS key and verify decrypt. ETA for running tests: Thursday.
legal-bot: Reminder: any joint announcement requires a 5-business-day embargo for review. Submit quotes to legal@redwood.ai by Tue 12pm.
Alyssa: Action items: (1) Jordan to share SAML metadata + cert thumbprint; (2) Samir to run HSM attestation script and post logs; (3) Claire to run smoke tests Thursday; (4) Maria to prepare draft quote and assets. Can folks ack?
Samir: Ack. I'll upload attestation log to the partner bucket and ping here when done.
Jordan: I'll drop metadata + cert here in thread once I get it from infra (should be in 2 hours). Also confirming launch window: target marketplace publish on 2024-07-09, joint announcement 2024-07-10 (post-embargo). If any blocker, flag today.
Maria: Acked. I'll have the draft quote by Friday morning and will loop legal. :thumbsup:
Claire: Got it — running tests Thursday morning, will post results here.
Jordan: Thanks all. If anything fails, we'll fallback to delayed announce and keep partner updated. 🚀
